dedupe_keys.name: warma zambia flood forecast and flood alert reports

description: Zambia's Water Resources Management Authority (WARMA) publishes flood forecast reports as downloadable flood alert reports on its website. On 27 September 2026 the page listed flood alert reports dated 18 February 2022, 25 February 2022, 3 February 2022, 3 March 2022, 5 January 2023, 17 January 2023, 21 January 2023, 26 January 2023 and 10 February 2023, and a flood alert report for Kalumbila dated 4 April 2023. Coverage is the catchments managed by WARMA in Zambia during the 2021/22 and 2022/23 rainy seasons. Access is free as downloadable reports. Caveats: the reports were not opened, so their content (rivers, gauges, thresholds) is not described here, and nothing newer than April 2023 was listed. Simulation uses: dated flood alerts as a record of flood events for validating flood exposure and warning studies in Zambia. Related records: Kariba lake levels (data-zra-kariba-lake-levels-reservoir-river-flows) and South African dam volumes (data-mzansi-amanzi-south-africa-monthly-surface-water-dam-volumes).
